lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Observable arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters located posterior to the gill slits, forming a series of approximately five horizontal rows with varying inter-pixel distances across the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with primary horizontal blob rows, forming a visible grid-like coordinate system on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, showing high intensity on the dorsal edge and lower intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparsely distributed high-luminance circular clusters located within the bounds of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily concentrated along the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor structural irregularities and notches are visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
